content.title: Schneider Electric 391-3724 Soft Starter - V/f Scalar Control, 400% Overload for 10 s
content.short_description: Schneider Electric 391-3724 soft starter with V/f scalar control and 400% overload capacity for 10 seconds. Suited for controlled motor starting in industrial applications.
content.long_description:
The Schneider Electric 391-3724 is a soft starter device designed to manage motor start-up using V/f (voltage/frequency) scalar control. This control method regulates motor voltage relative to frequency, providing a defined starting torque profile without the need for vector-based feedback systems.

The unit is rated for an overload capacity of 400% for 10 seconds, allowing it to handle short-duration current surges above nominal rated levels during motor starting or transient load conditions. This rating should be cross-checked against the specific motor's full load current and starting requirements to confirm compatibility.

As a soft starter, the 391-3724 is intended to reduce mechanical and electrical stress on motors and connected equipment during start and stop cycles compared to direct-on-line starting methods. It falls under Schneider Electric's Drives & Controls product line for industrial electrical applications.

Procurement and maintenance teams should verify voltage class, current rating, and enclosure specifications against the full product datasheet prior to installation, as these details are not included in the attributes listed here.
